confidence_notes: Low confidence. No city-level cost-of-living index was found for Victoria Falls. The five price searches returned mainly travel-guide aggregators and lodge-cafe rate pages. Best supported: cappuccino (US$3 at two cafes of one lodge group) and inexpensive meal (about US$10 per a budget guide; local cafes about US$7-15). Beer is set below that guide's roughly US$5 per-pint figure, based on my general knowledge of typical restaurant bottle prices. Mid-range meal for two is inferred from per-person ranges of about US$15-40 for three courses, no drinks. No direct wine or cocktail prices were found, so both are set from beer ratios (cocktail about 2x beer, wine glass about 1.6x beer). Accommodation anchors are holistic general-knowledge estimates for July peak-season USD pricing. No accommodation searches or live listings were used, and these are the least certain anchors. FX was read from RBA page text returned by one search.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a USD-quoted safari-gateway town comparable to Livingstone (Zambia) and Kasane (Botswana). Local cafes and bars are inexpensive, while hotel and lodge venues carry a premium. A Bradt guide snippet in the results described prices as far below Europe but usually higher than South Africa.
